56.1    BMRC has built an image of safety conscious organisation meticulously over a period
of seven years. Any reportable accident (fatality / injury) results in loss of life and/or
property damage. These accidents not only result in loss of life but also damage the
reputation of BMRC. Most of the accidents are avoidable and caused preliminary due
to contractors’ negligence. Hence BMRC shall recover the cost of damages from the
contractors for every reportable incident (fatality / injury).
56.2      In addition every BMRC work  site  is exposed to public scrutiny as the work  is
executed just on the right-of-way. Any unsafe act  / unsafe condition observed by
public further damages our reputation. Because of the non-voluntary compliance of
contractors to the condition of contract on SHE and project SHE manual, BMRC has
been forced to establish safety-enforcing organisation. The cost of established such
organisation is to be recovered from contractors for all observed safety violations at
